What Atlas does

Four trades. One crew to call.

The Angi listing covers a lot of ground. It breaks down into four main trades — tap any one to start an estimate for exactly that kind of work.

Asphalt Paving

New driveways, full tear-out and repave, patching failed sections, parking lots and striping. When the surface is too far gone to coat, this is the fix.

  • Driveway install & replacement
  • Repair & patching
  • Parking lots
  • Striping

Sealcoating

Sound but faded asphalt doesn't need replacing — it needs protecting. Sealcoating restores the deep black finish and shields the surface from water, sun and wear.

  • Driveway sealcoating
  • Parking lot sealcoating
  • Crack filling

Masonry

Brick and stone work — tuckpointing crumbling mortar, rebuilding stoops and steps, and repairing or replacing brick and stone siding and stucco.

  • Tuckpointing
  • Stoops & steps
  • Brick & stone siding
  • Stucco

Waterproofing & Foundations

Water in the basement starts outside the wall. Foundation waterproofing, drainage and foundation repair to keep the structure dry from the ground up.

  • Basement waterproofing
  • Foundation repair
  • Foundation drainage
  • Drywells
